Fuzzy String Index

Source: R/resolve.R
resolve.fuzzy_index.Rd

An index over a vocabulary of strings (species names, say) that finds the entries within a few edits of a query: Damerau-Levenshtein distance, where an insertion, a deletion, a substitution and, with damerau, a swap of two adjacent characters each cost one edit. Query it with resolve.fuzzy_match().

Usage

resolve.fuzzy_index(
  entries,
  maxEditDistance = NULL,
  caseInsensitive = NULL,
  damerau = NULL,
  buckets = NULL
)

Arguments

entries

Character vector, the vocabulary.

maxEditDistance

The largest edit distance a query may ask for.

caseInsensitive

Fold case of entries and queries before matching.

damerau

Count a swap of two adjacent characters as one edit.

buckets

Optional character vector, one bucket per entry (the genus of a species name, say): a query given a bucket hint searches that bucket first and falls back to the whole vocabulary when it finds nothing there.

Value

A FuzzyIndex object (an Rcpp module class) with methods size(), bucket_count() and max_supported_distance().

Details

Settings left NULL take the RESOLVE engine's defaults.

Examples

index <- resolve.fuzzy_index(c("Quercus robur", "Quercus petraea", "Fagus sylvatica"))
resolve.fuzzy_match(index, c("Quercus robr", "Fagus silvatica"))
